summary: P1 (branch_id filter for Agenda/Inventory/Sales + branch dropdown in NewAppointmentModal) — full backend + frontend regression. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_branch_filter_p1.py with 11 tests covering (a) GET /api/clinic/appointments filters by branch_id (no-filter, BRANCH_MAIN, BRANCH_Z15 — none of the cross-branch rows leak), (b) POST /api/clinic/appointments persists branch_id end-to-end (created apt for Z15 → appears only in Z15-filtered list, NOT in MAIN-filtered list), (c) POST without branch_id stores null (backwards compat), (d) Inventory stock/movements + Sales list/daily-summary + Sales cash-sessions/cash-registers all accept branch_id query param with 200. Result: 11/11 PASS in 16s. Re-ran prior regression (test_phase2_refactor_regression.py 44 + test_dashboard_prompt_a9.py 19) → 63/63 PASS in 27s. Frontend: live Playwright run on https://super-admin-panel-12.preview.emergentagent.com confirmed every URL contract from the review request: AgendaPage fetchAppointments adds branch_id=<activeBranch.id> (Sede Central=79c47aab…), NewAppointmentModal renders [data-testid=apt-branch-select] (count=1, multiBranch=true, branches.length=2), Inventory StockTab calls /inventory/stock?branch_id=<id>, Inventory MovementsTab calls /inventory/movements?...&branch_id=<id>, Sales DailySalesTab calls BOTH /sales/daily-summary?branch_id=<id> AND /sales?...&branch_id=<id>, Sales SessionsTab calls BOTH /sales/cash-sessions?...&branch_id=<id> AND /sales/cash-registers?branch_id=<id>. Sidebar branch picker shows 'Sede Central (Principal)' as activeBranch.

issues: React console warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' inside AgendaPage list render. Cosmetic only — does not affect functionality. Recommended to add key={apt.id} (or similar) to the missing list children.
Radix DialogContent missing 'Description' or aria-describedby={undefined}. Accessibility nit; add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby attribute.

action_items: Optional cosmetic: add unique key prop to the list rendered inside AgendaPage to silence React console warning.
Optional a11y: add <DialogDescription> (or aria-describedby) to NewAppointmentModal and AppointmentDetailsModal Dialog containers.
Optional follow-up: previous iter 19 minor items remain (5xx instead of 404 on GET single-resource missing IDs in patients/prescriptions/lab-orders). Not introduced by P1; not regressed.
Note: ReportsPage / ExpensesPage / AccountsReceivablePage were intentionally excluded from this iteration per main agent's note.
critical_code_review_comments: appointments.py list_appointments adds .eq('branch_id', branch_id) cleanly — implementation is correct and minimal.

AppointmentCreate / AppointmentUpdate Pydantic models extended with Optional[str] branch_id — backwards compatible: existing callers without the field still work and produce branch_id=null in DB (verified live).
Frontend AgendaPage useCallback deps array correctly includes multiBranch + activeBranch?.id, so the network call is automatically refetched when the user switches branch.

NewAppointmentModal default cascade (activeBranch?.id || branches.find(is_main)?.id || branches[0]?.id || '') is robust — also degrades safely when multi_branch is off (select is not rendered, body still posts branch_id=null since form.branch_id stays falsy when branches.length===0; verify when feature is off and clinic has 0/1 branches).

InventoryPage StockTab/MovementsTab and SalesPage DailySalesTab/SessionsTab correctly default branchFilter from activeBranch.id and refetch via useEffect — all 6 endpoints observed with branch_id in URL during live run.

appointments.py POST does NOT validate that data.branch_id actually belongs to the same clinic_id. A malicious or buggy client could post branch_id of another clinic's branch (still gets stored, but invisible to that clinic's filtered queries). Low severity (RLS-protected on read), but recommend an explicit check: SELECT branches WHERE id=branch_id AND clinic_id=ctx_clinic_id.
appointments.py update_appointment respects branch_id via update_data filter (model_dump excludes None) — change-of-branch is supported, but again no clinic_id ownership check.
Cosmetic: AgendaPage emits a React 'unique key prop' console warning during render — not new in this iteration but visible while testing.
